concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / design refinement. Create ONE polished full-screen portrait 9:19.5 mobile screen proposal for Halovat's Qibla page.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the selected Qibla UI concept and must be improved according to this brief, not copied unchanged. Image 2 is the EXACT existing Home-page 3D mosque artwork to insert as a small thumbnail in the "Yaqin masjidlar" button. Preserve its ivory body, large emerald dome, one ivory-and-green minaret, golden crescents and nice 3D material. No substitute outline mosque icon.
Key corrections to Image 1:
1. Change the main 3D scene camera to FIRST-PERSON POV as if the user is holding their phone naturally and looking ahead through its camera. It is the view INSIDE the app, NOT a photograph of a hand holding a phone. No visible hands, no outer phone hardware frame, and NO miniature phone sitting on the scene's ground. The viewer is the current position. Ground and horizon use eye-level forward perspective, not overhead map/isometric view. Render Kaaba ahead and a little right, with natural scale and perspective. Clean abstract pale-mint/ivory floor, no crowds, city, camera permission UI or unrelated photo background.
2. Replace the LONG curved directional ribbon with one SMALL nearby emerald 3D arrow or chevron in the lower foreground, indicating slightly right; arrow length only 5–8% of viewport height. No long path or line connecting arrow to Kaaba. A very subtle short circular base or soft shadow under small arrow is okay. Keep guidance visually understandable.
3. ALL TYPOGRAPHY MUST match CURRENT APP: native iOS SF Pro / system sans-serif, regular/medium/semibold weights, tabular sans-serif numerals. Absolutely NO serif type, NO high-contrast editorial serifs, NO calligraphy, NO italic display font. Screen title 22–24pt semibold, body 13–15pt, large degree value about 48–56pt semibold; practical app-scale, no giant poster typography.
4. Bottom "Yaqin masjidlar" navigation button must embed Image 2's actual 3D mosque as a nicely sized left thumbnail, label at center-left and thin chevron at right. Minimal pale-mint or cream rounded rectangular row, delicate stroke, no exaggerated glass.
KEEP app brand palette: warm ivory #FAF9F5, dark emerald #064E3B, restrained mint #BFF1DB, tiny Kaaba gold accents. Crisp shippable iOS UI with purposeful spacing, quiet shadows, fine separators. Main scene feels 3D and sophisticated while controls remain clean and friendly.
Required readable Uzbek UI: "Qibla"; location row "Toshkent" and "GPS · ±17 m" with discreet location icon and edit icon; clear data "52°" and "O‘ngga buring"; secondary line "Qibla 240° · Telefon 188°". Compact outlined native "Qayta sozlash" button and the 3D-mosque "Yaqin masjidlar" action. No new features, no calibration paragraphs, no maps.
Persistent bottom native-looking tab bar, FIVE icons and labels: home "Bosh sahifa", calendar "Namozlar", dotted tasbeeh "Tasbeh", compass "Qibla" active emerald, person "Profil". All fit comfortably without scrolling; include subtle status bar and bottom safe area.
Kaaba must remain recognizable: enclosed black cuboid with textile drape, broad ornate gold embroidered band near upper portion and golden door on one face, no open top, no roof/dome. Keep it physically plausible and beautifully rendered. No watermark, no annotations outside screen, no collage.
VARIANT A: OPEN CAMERA VIEW. Small centered native Qibla header and a slim location row. Main 3D view blends seamlessly into warm ivory page, no enclosing card, around 42% of screen height. Camera eye-level at human height with low quiet horizon: Kaaba stands ahead slightly to the right in upper-middle scene, moderate size; see front and a little right face with natural perspective, NOT top-down. Floor recedes gently with just two faint perspective seams and soft mint lighting, not a long arrow or grid. ONE short thick emerald chevron floats a few centimeters above the nearby floor in lower center-right; crisp 3D bevel and soft contact shadow. First-person immersive calm. Beneath scene centered "52°" and "O‘ngga buring" in clean SF Pro sans-serif, supporting bearing line; a quiet divider; compact calibration button; 3D mosque navigation row above navbar. The main layout should be lighter and spacious, with a clean premium mobile product feeling.
